review_notes: Five read-only table functions with optional explicit bearer token plus static fhir_servers view. Complete native args/result-schema metadata and five view columns retained. No physical tables/COPY/hidden authenticated registrations. All6 remain denominator; fixtures use no credentials and all retrievals address only explicitly authored loopback inventory. Complete release/current diff reviewed: changes only in Metadata() prose/example lists, catalog agent tasks/schema example lists, new examples.go and their tests. Function registration, argument structs/ArgumentSpecs, bind/output schemas, state/process behavior, view definition, HTTP/pagination/flattening implementation and dependencies are unchanged. Exact-current binary was not built or executed; current compatibility is source-reviewed, distinct from exact release runtime.
